name: Steam
note: Steam Support does not publish a dedicated 'Steam client keyboard shortcuts' article (the FAQ id given in the task, 1B3B-6D0D-7C4D-8AC9, 404s); the three shortcuts here are the only ones Valve documents in prose across its official FAQ articles: the Steam Community Overlay's open key (Shift+Tab, from the 'Steam Community Overlay' article), its screenshot key (F12, same article), and the Big Picture mode fullscreen toggle (Alt+Enter, from the 'Steam's Big Picture mode' article). Per-game developer-console shortcuts (~) and Steam Deck/controller button chords are out of scope (not Steam-client keyboard shortcuts). Big Picture mode's on-screen navigation is designed for a controller and has no other documented keyboard bindings.
